scene.prelude: __sdfGame.setHullExitBound(true); __sdfGame.step(2); (() => { __sdfGame.setWoundTuning({ spillChance: 0 }); const m = __sdfGameDebug.normalCaptureState().camera; const r3 = (v) => Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000; const eye = [r3(m[12]), r3(m[13]), r3(m[14])]; let n = 0; for (const [a, b, kind] of [[0, 0, "slug"], [0.15, 0.1, "pellet"], [-0.12, -0.12, "pellet"]]) { let d = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => -m[8 + i] + a * m[i] + b * m[4 + i]); const L = Math.hypot(d[0], d[1], d[2]); d = d.map((v) => r3(v / L)); if (__sdfGame.stampWoundAt(eye[0], eye[1], eye[2], d[0], d[1], d[2], kind, 1)) n++; } __sdfGame.step(5); if (!n) throw new Error("no wound stamped on body 1"); return n; })()
